about: Bounding rects of the shell and of every place it draws, recorded on the base commit (996db71) before the layout contract changed a rule; tests/layout_contract_render.test.mjs compares v1 with it. CSS px rounded to 0.01. A box is [left, top, width, height]; kids are the layer's children as [left, width] (their height follows the font). One entry per window size (device px @ zoom), mode (build, vibe, classic) and rail (closed, pinned).
